status: declared by the pull request that closes #387 (track Z of #374) before any score was computed; the choices it leaves to Eleonora (the window cut-off, the window benchmarks, the treasury_settlement size left out) are listed in that pull request

model.structure: discrete-time first-passage hazard lambda_k = P(first pressure day is lead k | none before), pooled over leads k = 1..h with a dummy per lead, the spread decaying as 1/k, the lead's pressure-day type (quarter end, month end, tax date) alone and times the reserves scarcity state, and the decision's spread, reserves and TGA change (alone and times reserves)
model.per_day: P(pressure on lead h) = sum_j F_j * q_(h-j), F_j the first-passage probability, q_m the probability the pressure persists m days past the first pressure day (a second pooled logistic on the training episodes)
model.window: P(at least one pressure day in the next N business days) = 1 - prod_(k<=N)(1 - lambda_k), from decision-instant covariates at horizon 1
model.estimator: scikit-learn LogisticRegression, C = 1.0, L2, columns standardised on the fit rows, as ml.PRESSURE_LOGISTIC_SETTINGS
model.labels: one fit per threshold on that threshold's own pressure-day label (+5 bp and +10 bp), never an all-days loss
model.treasury_settlement: left out at every horizon: its size is public one business day ahead only (#170), and the lead's settlement terms enter through the pressure-day type of the lead's date

benchmarks.climatology: frequency of the window event among training decisions with the same set of pressure-day types in their window, the global frequency where fewer than 10 decisions share the set
benchmarks.persistence: logistic on the latest public spread, fitted to the window label
